entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina mfumuko wa bei

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Mfumuko wa bei humaanisha pesa zako hununua kidogo kadri muda unavyopita. Bitcoin ni pesa nzuri kwa sababu haina mfumuko wa bei.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Ugavi wa dola ya Australia hauna kikomo, jambo linalomaanisha kwamba zaidi inaweza kuchapishwa wakati wowote.

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Kihistoria, Bitcoin imepata nguvu ya kununua kadri muda unavyopita, huku dola ya Australia imeipoteza. Wengi hutumia Bitcoin kama akaunti ya akiba ya muda mrefu — pesa wanazoiacha ikue kwa miaka bila kuigusa.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Je, ungependa kuweka akiba kwa dola za Australia ambazo zinanunua kidogo kadri muda unavyopita? Au katika Bitcoin, ambayo imekuwa ikinunua zaidi?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin pia ni chombo cha uhuru

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Hakuna mtu anayedhibiti mtandao wa Bitcoin. Hauendeshwi na serikali yoyote au kampuni yoyote. Umejengwa ili kulinda uhuru wako na pesa zako.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Watu duniani kote tayari wanatumia Bitcoin kulinda uhuru wao — hata pale serikali zao zinapokataa kuwasaidia au kujaribu kuwasimamisha.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa unaweka akiba kwa dola za Australia, pengine umegundua kwamba kila mwaka unaweza kununua kidogo. Unahitaji dola za Australia zaidi ili kununua kiasi kile kile cha bidhaa. Unahitaji dola za Australia zaidi ili kudumisha hali yako ya maisha.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Lakini si lazima iwe hivyo.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Katika miaka minne iliyopita, watu wanaoweka akiba katika Bitcoin wameona maisha yakizidi kuwa nafuu.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Hapa kuna ushahidi: pesa zako zinapoteza thamani

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: Kila dola ya Australia iliyo kwenye akaunti yako ya benki inanunua kidogo kila mwaka. Hii hutokea kwa sababu hakuna kikomo cha kiasi cha dola za Australia kinachoweza kuundwa.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Ugavi huu usio na kikomo ndio sababu kuu ya mfumuko wa bei. Katika miaka michache iliyopita, kiasi cha dola za Australia kinachozunguka kimeongezeka kwa kiwango kikubwa.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Hakuna mtu anayedhibiti mtandao wa Bitcoin. Hauendeshwi na serikali yoyote au kampuni yoyote. Umejengwa ili kulinda uhuru wako na pesa zako.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transaction fees are transparent, predictable, and typically very low. Banks often have hidden fees, monthly account fees, overdraft charges, wire transfer fees, ATM fees, and other penalties that can add up significantly over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin fees are transparent and predictable. Banks stack on hidden account, overdraft, wire, and ATM fees over time.
entries.currentValue: Ada za miamala ya Bitcoin ni wazi, zinazotabirika, na kwa kawaida ni ndogo sana. Benki mara nyingi zina ada zilizofichwa, ada za kila mwezi za akaunti, malipo ya overdraft, ada za uhamisho wa waya, ada za ATM, na adhabu nyingine ambazo zinaweza kujumlika sana kwa muda.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin prevents you from spending money you don't have - you can only spend Bitcoin that you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts (spending more than your account balance) and then charge substantial fees for this 'service,' often leading to cascading penalty charges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin only lets you spend what you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts, then charge cascading penalty fees for the privilege.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inakuzuia kutumia pesa ambazo huna - unaweza tu kutumia Bitcoin unayomiliki kweli. Benki zinaruhusu overdraft (kutumia zaidi ya salio la akaunti yako) na kisha zinakutoza ada kubwa kwa 'huduma' hii, mara nyingi ikisababisha adhabu za mfululizo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inakuruhusu tu kutumia kile unachomiliki kwa kweli. Benki zinaruhusu overdraft, kisha hutoza ada za adhabu mfululizo kwa upendeleo huo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transactions are censorship resistant - once broadcast to the network, they cannot be stopped or reversed by any central authority. entries.englishValue: Once broadcast, Bitcoin transactions can't be stopped or reversed. Banks can block, freeze, or reverse transactions based on policy or government orders.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves over the internet anywhere in minutes. Cash needs physical presence or trusted couriers — you can't email a $20 bill.

entries.englishValue: Cash can be counterfeited, sometimes convincingly. Bitcoin uses cryptography that makes counterfeiting mathematically impossible.

entries.englishValue: CBDCs require trusting custodians like banks or governments to hold your money for you.

entries.targetTranslation: CBDC zinahitaji kuamini wahifadhi kama benki au serikali kushikilia pesa zako kwa niaba yako.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a predictable monetary policy that is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs, like our currencies today, have a monetary policy that can easily be changed.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's monetary policy is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs can be reprogrammed at will by politicians, causing
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina sera ya fedha inayotabirika ambayo imewekwa katika msimbo na haiwezi kubadilishwa. CBDC, kama sarafu zetu za leo, zina sera ya fedha ambayo inaweza kubadilishwa kwa urahisi.
entries.targetTranslation: Sera ya fedha ya Bitcoin imewekwa katika msimbo na haiwezi kubadilishwa. CBDC zinaweza kupangwa upya kwa hiari na wanasiasa, zikisababisha

entries.englishValueBefore: This results in inflation when politicians print too much money.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Hii inasababisha mfumuko wa bei wakati wanasiasa wanachapisha pesa nyingi sana.
entries.targetTranslation: mfumuko wa bei

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's protocol has remained fundamentally unchanged since 2009, providing predictable rules that cannot be easily altered. Most crypto projects frequently update their protocols, change tokenomics, or fork into new versions, creating uncertainty for users.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Itifaki ya Bitcoin imebaki bila kubadilishwa kimsingi tangu 2009, ikitoa sheria zinazotabirika ambazo haziwezi kubadilishwa kwa urahisi. Miradi mingi ya crypto mara kwa mara inasasisha itifaki zao, kubadilisha uchumi wa tokeni, au kutenganisha kuwa toleo mpya, na kuunda kutokuwa na uhakika kwa watumiaji.
entries.targetTranslation: Itifaki ya Bitcoin imesalia ile ile kimsingi tangu 2009, ikitoa sheria zinazotabirika. Miradi mingi ya crypto kwa kuendelea hubadilisha itifaki, tokenomics, au kugawanyika kuwa matoleo mapya.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya kazi kwenye mtandao uliogatuliwa kweli kweli na makumi ya maelfu ya nodi huru duniani kote. Miradi mingi ya crypto inadhibitiwa na mashirika, makampuni, au vikundi vidogo vya watengenezaji ambao wanaweza kufanya maamuzi ya upande mmoja kuhusu mustakabali wa itifaki.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin huendeshwa na makumi ya maelfu ya nodi huru duniani kote. Miradi mingi ya crypto inadhibitiwa na mashirika, makampuni, au timu ndogo za watengenezaji ambao wanaweza kufanya mabadiliko ya upande mmoja.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina kikomo cha juu cha sarafu milioni 21 ambazo zitawepo, na kuifanya kuwa mali adimu zaidi ya kidijitali. Miradi mingi ya crypto ina ugavi usio na kikomo, taratibu za mfumuko, au inaweza kutengeneza tokeni mpya kwa hiari, ikipunguza thamani ya wenye tokeni kwa muda.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ina kikomo kigumu cha sarafu milioni 21 — mali adimu zaidi ya kidijitali. Miradi mingi ya crypto ina ugavi usio na kikomo au taratibu za kutengeneza tokeni mpya kwa hiari, zikiwapunguzia thamani wamiliki.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina madhumuni moja rahisi: pesa za kidijitali za rika kwa rika. Mtu yeyote anaweza kuelewa na kuitumia kwa ujuzi wa msingi. Miradi mingi ya crypto inahusisha mikataba ngumu ya smart, itifaki za DeFi, au taratibu za utawala ambazo zinahitaji ujuzi wa kitaalamu kutumia kwa usalama.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ina madhumuni moja: pesa za kidijitali za rika kwa rika. Mtu yeyote anaweza kuielewa na kuitumia. Crypto nyingi inahusisha mikataba mahiri changamano au DeFi inayohitaji utaalamu wa kiufundi kuitumia kwa usalama.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inatumia makubaliano ya Uthibitisho wa Kazi, ambayo yamejaribiwa vitani kwa zaidi ya miaka 15 bila shambulio moja lililofanikiwa kwenye mtandao mkuu. Miradi mingi ya crypto inatumia taratibu za makubaliano za majaribio kama Uthibitisho wa Hisa au mifumo ya uwakilishi ambayo haijathibitisha usalama wao wa muda mrefu.
entries.targetTranslation: Proof of Work ya Bitcoin imefanya kazi bila shambulio lililofanikiwa kwenye mtandao mkuu kwa zaidi ya miaka 15. Miradi mingi ya crypto hutumia makubaliano ya majaribio ambayo hayajajaribiwa vitani.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inatumika kama pesa za kidijitali - hifadhi ya thamani na njia ya kubadilishana. Tokeni nyingi za crypto ni tokeni za matumizi kwa majukwaa maalum, tokeni za utawala, au mali za kudhaniana zenye mapendekezo yasiyo wazi ya thamani halisi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ni pesa ya kidijitali — hifadhi ya thamani na njia ya kubadilishana. Tokeni nyingi za crypto ni za matumizi za kudhaniana au tokeni za utawala zenye thamani isiyo wazi katika ulimwengu halisi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inakuwa na nguvu zaidi chini ya mashambulizi na imenusurika kila mgogoro, marufuku, na ukosoaji ulioshushwa juu yake. Miradi mingi ya crypto ni dhaifu na inaweza kuanguka kutokana na shinikizo la udhibiti, kushindwa kwa kiufundi, au kushuka kwa soko.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inakua na nguvu chini ya mashambulizi na imenusurika kila mgogoro, marufuku, na ukosoaji. Miradi mingi ya crypto huanguka chini ya shinikizo la udhibiti, kiufundi, au la soko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin haina CEO, hakuna kampuni nyuma yake, na hakuna sehemu moja ya kushindikana. Miradi mingi ya crypto inasaidiwa na makampuni ya mtaji wa hatari, ina timu za uongozi zinazotambuliwa, au inategemea makampuni maalum kwa operesheni yao kuendelea.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina CEO, hakuna kampuni, hakuna sehemu moja ya kushindikana. Miradi mingi ya crypto inategemea VC, uongozi maalum, au kuishi kwa kampuni moja.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanana kabisa, ikimaanisha kila bitcoin inafanana na inabadilishana - bitcoin moja ni sawa na bitcoin moja popote duniani. Sanaa nzuri kwa asili haifanani, kila kipande kikiwa cha kipekee katika uumbaji wake, historia, hali, na asili yake, na kuifanya mlinganisho na tathmini za moja kwa moja kuwa ngumu sana.
entries.targetTranslation: Kila bitcoin inafanana na inabadilishana. Kila kazi ya sanaa ni ya kipekee — uumbaji tofauti, historia, hali, na asili hufanya mlinganisho wa moja kwa moja kuwa mgumu sana.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya biashara kwenye soko la 24/7 duniani kote ambapo mtu yeyote mwenye ufikiaji wa mtandao anaweza kununua au kuuza papo hapo. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji nyumba maalum za minada kama Sotheby's au Christie's, wafanyabiashara wa kibinafsi, au matunzio ya kipekee. Mauzo yanaweza kuchukua miezi kupanga na kukamilika, na ufikiaji mdogo wa soko na fursa za biashara zisizo za kawaida.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin hufanya biashara 24/7 kwenye soko la kimataifa linalopatikana kwa mtu yeyote. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji nyumba maalum za minada, wauzaji wa kibinafsi, au maonyesho na inaweza kuchukua miezi kuuza.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Kununua au kuuza bitcoin kwa kawaida hugharimu chini ya 1% ya ada, mara nyingi chini zaidi. Mauzo ya sanaa nzuri yanahusisha gharama kubwa ikiwa ni pamoja na ada za mnunuzi (10-25%), kamisheni za muuzaji (10-15%), bima, usafirishaji, uhifadhi, na ada za uthibitishaji. Gharama hizi kwa pamoja zinaweza kwa urahisi kuzidi 30-40% ya thamani ya kazi ya sanaa katika muamala mmoja.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kugawanywa katika sats milioni 100, ikiruhusu mtu yeyote kuingia kwa kiasi chochote. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji kiasi kikubwa cha pesa — uchoraji mmoja unaweza kugharimu mamilioni, ukiwafunga wengi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inaweza kugawanywa kuwa vitengo vidogo milioni 100 vinavyoitwa satoshi, ikiifanya kuwa nzuri kwa miamala ya ukubwa wowote kutoka miamala ndogo hadi ununuzi mkubwa. Sanaa nzuri haiwezi kugawanywa - huwezi kumiliki sehemu ya picha au kuuza sehemu tu ya sanamu. Kutogawanyika huku kunapunguza kubadilika kwa uwekezaji na chaguzi za ukwasi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bei ya Bitcoin ni ya wazi na inaonyeshwa kwa wakati halisi kwenye masoko ya kimataifa. Tathmini za sanaa nzuri ni za kibinafsi, zinategemea wataalamu, na zinaweza kutofautiana sana kati ya wanunuzi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Umiliki na uhalisi wa Bitcoin unaweza kuthibitishwa kwa kryptografia kwenye blockchain na mtu yeyote mwenye ujuzi wa msingi wa kiufundi. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji uthibitishaji wa kitaalamu wa gharama kubwa, utafiti wa asili, na uchambuzi wa kisayansi. Hata na uthibitishaji wa kitaalamu, bandia mara kwa mara hudanganya ulimwengu wa sanaa, na mizozo ya uthibitishaji inaweza kuharibu thamani ya kazi ya sanaa usiku mmoja. Bitcoin, kwa upande mwingine, haiwezi kughushiwa au kubandiwa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haihitaji bima maalum, hifadhi za hali ya hewa, au usalama. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji bima ya gharama kubwa, hali ya hewa inayodhibitiwa, na ulinzi dhidi ya wizi, moto, na uharibifu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, ikihifadhiwa vizuri, haiwezi kuharibiwa na mafuriko, moto, matetemeko ya ardhi, vimbunga, wizi, au maafa mengine. Sanaa nzuri iko hatarini kwa aina zote za uharibifu wa kimwili na kuzorota. Hata na uhifadhi wa udhibiti wa hali ya hewa wa gharama kubwa na bima kamili, kazi za sanaa zinaweza kuharibiwa na mambo ya mazingira, ajali, au maafa ya asili, na uwezekano wa kupoteza thamani yote.
entries.targetTranslation: Uthibitisho wa Bitcoin ni wa moja kwa moja kupitia kriptografia. Sanaa nzuri inakabiliwa na ughushi mara kwa mara, na hata wataalamu wanaweza kudanganywa na nakala za hali ya juu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inaweza kununuliwa na kuuzwa na mtu yeyote mwenye ufikiaji wa mtandao na kiasi kidogo cha pesa za kuwekeza. Uwekezaji wa sanaa nzuri kwa kiasi kikubwa umepunguzwa kwa wakusanyaji matajiri kutokana na bei za chini za juu, ufikiaji wa minada wa kipekee, mahitaji ya uhifadhi, gharama za bima, na ujuzi maalum unaohitajika ili kuvinjari soko la sanaa kwa mafanikio.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuhamishwa popote duniani ndani ya dakika kwa ada ndogo. Sanaa nzuri inahitaji usafirishaji maalum, kibali cha forodha, na inaweza kuchukua wiki au miezi kusafirisha kimataifa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Kwa sababu Bitcoin ni ya kidijitali, inaweza kutumwa karibu papo hapo kwa ada ndogo sana na mtu yeyote mwenye muunganisho wa Mtandao. Kwa sababu Dhahabu ni ya kimwili, haiwezi kuhamishwa kupitia Mtandao na lazima itumwe kimwili kuhamisha umiliki.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ina kikomo kigumu cha milioni 21 BTC. Ugavi wa dhahabu hukua takriban 1.6% kwa mwaka, ukipunguza sehemu yako — chini ya fiat lakini bado kupungua.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ni mali ya asili ya kidijitali, ikimaanisha unaweza kuhamisha umiliki kamili kupitia Mtandao. Baadhi ya makampuni yanatoa uwezo wa kununua dhahabu mtandaoni bila kupokea dhahabu halisi, badala yake unaaminisha kampuni kushikilia dhahabu kwa niaba yako. Hii ni kama Hati ya Kidijitali ya Deni kwani unamiliki tu ahadi kutoka kwa kampuni badala ya mali halisi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuthibitishwa kihesabu papo hapo. Dhahabu inahitaji wataalamu wa kemikali na zana maalum kuthibitisha — na hata hivyo, ughushi tata umewahi kufanikiwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 Million BTC that will ever exist.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina kikomo cha juu cha BTC Milioni 21 ambazo zitawepo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kutumwa popote duniani ndani ya dakika. Kuhamisha dhahabu kunahitaji usafirishaji wa kimwili, bima, na linaweza kuchukua siku au wiki.

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Ugavi mpya wa dhahabu unachimbwa kutoka ardhini kila mwaka, na kusababisha mfumuko wa bei wa ugavi wote. Inakadiriwa kuwa ugavi wote wa dhahabu unaongezeka kwa takriban 1.6% kwa mwaka, ikimaanisha sehemu yako ya keki inapungua kwa 1.6% kwa mwaka.
entries.targetTranslation: mfumuko wa bei

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: Hii ni chini ya mfumuko wa bei wa fiat, lakini bado ni mfumuko wa bei.
entries.targetTranslation: — lakini bado mfumuko wa bei.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Dhahabu ina ugavi unaonyumbulika, ikimaanisha kadiri bei ya dhahabu inavyopanda, kuna motisha kubwa zaidi ya kuchimba dhahabu zaidi. Hii mara nyingi inaweka shinikizo la kushuka kwa bei ya dhahabu kadiri migodi mipya inavyoanza kufanya kazi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kugawanywa hadi sehemu milioni 100 za sarafu (sats). Dhahabu ina vikomo vya kiutendaji — huwezi kutumia mikrogramu ya dhahabu mkutano.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Mtandao wa Bitcoin umegatuliwa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuhifadhiwa kwa usalama kwenye kifaa kidogo au hata kukariri akilini. Dhahabu inahitaji nafasi ya kimwili, ulinzi, na inaweza kuibwa kwa nguvu.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Na Bitcoin, ni rahisi sana kuthibitisha kuwa una Bitcoin halisi kwa kuchukua uhifadhi wa kibinafsi wa sarafu zako na kuendesha nodi kamili.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin huendeshwa kwenye mtandao uliogatuliwa wa kimataifa. Soko la dhahabu linadhibitiwa na watu wachache wakuu na linaweza kuathiriwa na uingiliaji wa serikali na akiba kuu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Kama vile kuna senti 100 katika dola 1, kuna sats 100,000,000 katika Bitcoin 1. Hii inafanya Bitcoin iweze kutumika kwa ununuzi wa kiwango chochote, ikiwa ni pamoja na miamala ndogo ndogo ya senti chache.
entries.targetTranslation: Bei ya Bitcoin ni ya uwazi kabisa na inapatikana 24/7. Bei ya dhahabu mara nyingi hutofautiana kati ya masoko, ikiwa na utaratibu mdogo wa kuweka bei kati ya nchi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inaweza kuhamishwa popote duniani papo hapo kupitia mtandao. Mali isiyohamishika imewekwa kabisa mahali maalum na haiwezi kuhamishwa, ikiifanya iwe hatarini kwa hali za kiuchumi za ndani, maafa ya asili, na kutokuwa na utulivu wa kisiasa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuhamishwa popote duniani ndani ya dakika. Mali isiyohamishika ni — kweli — isiyohamishika; haiwezi kuhamishwa kati ya nchi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inaweza kugawanywa kuwa vitengo vidogo milioni 100 vinavyoitwa satoshi, ikiifanya kuwa nzuri kwa miamala ya ukubwa wowote. Mali isiyohamishika haiwezi kugawanywa kwa urahisi - huwezi kuuza jiko la nyumba yako tu au kununua nusu ya chumba cha kulala.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina ushuru wa mali, ada za matengenezo, au gharama za kufunga. Mali isiyohamishika inakuja na kodi ya mali ya kila mwaka, matengenezo, bima, na ada za kufunga 2–5%.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya kazi kwenye mtandao uliogatuliwa ambao hakuna serikali inayoweza kudhibiti. Mali isiyohamishika inakabiliwa na udhibiti mpana wa serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na udhibiti wa kodi, kusitishwa kwa kuondolewa, sheria za mpangilio wa matumizi, na haki ya serikali ambapo serikali zinaweza kunyang'anya mali yako.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kugawanywa kwa kiasi chochote — unaweza kununua $5 ya Bitcoin. Mali isiyohamishika inahitaji malipo makubwa ya awali, mara nyingi makumi au mamia ya maelfu ya dola.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin haihitaji matengenezo - ipo kama msimbo wa kidijitali kwenye mtandao. Mali isiyohamishika inahitaji matengenezo ya mara kwa mara ikiwa ni pamoja na ukarabati, maboresho, usimamizi wa mali, bima, na kushughulika na wapangaji ikiwa inapangishwa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inafanana — kila satoshi ni sawa na nyingine. Kila kipande cha mali isiyohamishika ni cha kipekee — eneo, hali, na sifa hutofautiana, na kufanya mlinganisho kuwa mgumu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin haina kodi zinazoendelea - unalipa tu kodi ya faida ya mtaji unapouza. Mali isiyohamishika inakabiliwa na kodi za mali za kila mwaka ambazo lazima zilipwe bila kujali mali inapata mapato au la, ikikushurutisha kwa ufanisi kukodi mali yako mwenyewe kutoka kwa serikali milele.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inafanya biashara 24/7 kwenye masoko ya kimataifa. Mali isiyohamishika inaweza kuchukua miezi kuuza, ikihitaji wakala, ukaguzi, na karatasi nyingi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin, ikihifadhiwa vizuri, haiwezi kuharibiwa na mafuriko, moto, matetemeko ya ardhi, vimbunga, au maafa mengine ya asili. Mali isiyohamishika iko hatarini kwa aina zote za uharibifu wa kimwili na inahitaji bima ya gharama kubwa ambayo inaweza isifildie hasara kamili.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuhifadhiwa kibinafsi bila wahusika wa tatu. Mali isiyohamishika inaweza kunyang'anywa kupitia eminent domain, kufuata kodi, au sheria nyingine za kiserikali.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Kila bitcoin inafanana na inabadilishana - bitcoin moja ni sawa na bitcoin moja popote duniani. Kila kipande cha mali isiyohamishika ni cha kipekee kwa maeneo, hali, na sifa tofauti, na kuifanya iwe ngumu kupanga bei na kulinganisha mali.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina ada za kuendelea kuhifadhi. Mali isiyohamishika inahitaji matengenezo ya mara kwa mara, ukarabati, na uboreshaji unaopunguza mapato yako halisi kwa muda.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inaweza kununuliwa na kuuzwa 24/7 na mtu yeyote mwenye ufikiaji wa mtandao popote duniani. Mauzo ya mali isiyohamishika yamepunguzwa kwa wanunuzi wa ndani, yanahitaji michakato mirefu na mawakili na madalali, na yanaweza kuchukua miezi kukamilika.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ni huria kabisa — bila ya mahali maalum unaohitaji kuwa. Mali isiyohamishika inakufunga kwa eneo, ikipunguza uhamaji wako na fursa za kazi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inawezesha umiliki wa moja kwa moja wa mtu binafsi bila wasuluhishi, ikiendeleza uhuru wa kifedha kwa kila mtu. Kununua mali isiyohamishika kama uwekezaji zaidi ya makazi yako ya msingi kunachangia ufedha wa nyumba, ikichukulia nyumba kama bidhaa badala ya makazi. Hii inasukuma bei juu, inapunguza uwezo wa kununua kwa familia, na kuchangia mgogoro wa nyumba na ukosefu wa makazi unaoathiri nchi nyingi leo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kuthibitishwa papo hapo kwa uhakika kamili. Umiliki wa mali isiyohamishika unahitaji utafiti wa hatimiliki, bima ya hatimiliki, na unaweza kuwa na changamoto za kisheria.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Unapomiliki Bitcoin, una umiliki wa moja kwa moja wa mali yenyewe. Unapomiliki hisa, unamiliki sehemu ya kampuni, ikimaanisha uwekezaji wako unategemea utendaji wa kampuni, maamuzi ya usimamizi, na mafanikio ya biashara.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina CEO, bodi, au timu ya usimamizi inayoweza kufanya makosa au ulaghai. Hisa zinategemea utendaji wa watendaji wachache na maamuzi yao yanaweza kuharibu thamani yako.

entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina kikomo cha juu cha BTC milioni 21 ambazo zitawepo.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inaweza kunolewa kibinafsi bila kuhitaji broker au kampuni ya udhibiti. Hisa lazima zihifadhiwe kupitia broker, na kuongeza hatari ya mhusika mwingine.

entries.englishValueBefore: Companies can issue new shares at any time, diluting existing shareholders' ownership percentage. This means your slice of the company gets smaller when new shares are created.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Makampuni yanaweza kutoa hisa mpya wakati wowote, kupunguza asilimia ya umiliki wa wenye hisa walio sasa. Hii inamaanisha sehemu yako ya kampuni inapungua wakati hisa mpya zinaundwa.
entries.targetTranslation: mfumuko wa bei

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still dilution.
entries.englishValue: dilutes cash. With Bitcoin, your slice never shrinks.
entries.currentValue: Hii ni chini ya mfumuko wa bei wa fiat, lakini bado ni upunguzaji.
entries.targetTranslation: hupunguza thamani ya pesa. Na Bitcoin, sehemu yako kamwe haipungui.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya kazi kwenye mtandao uliogatuliwa bila sehemu moja ya kushindikana. Uwekezaji wa hisa unakabiliwa na hatari ya mtu muhimu - ikiwa CEO au viongozi wengine muhimu wataondoka, kuugua, au kufanya maamuzi mabaya, uwekezaji wako unaweza kuathirika sana. Makampuni yanategemea sana timu zao za uongozi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inafanya biashara 24/7 kimataifa. Hisa hufanya biashara tu kwa saa fulani za soko, kufunga wikendi na sikukuu — na kuacha mwekezaji bila chaguo wakati wa migogoro.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Bei ya Bitcoin inaendeshwa kabisa na ugavi na mahitaji ya soko. Bei za hisa mara nyingi hutathminiwa kwa kutumia uwiano wa P/E (Bei-kwa-Mapato), unaoonyesha wawekezaji wanalipa kiasi gani kwa kila dola ya mapato ya kampuni. Uwiano wa juu wa P/E unaweza kuonyesha hisa zilizozidishwa bei, ikifanya iwe ngumu kuamua thamani ya haki.
entries.targetTranslation: Ugavi wa Bitcoin umewekwa katika milioni 21 milele. Kampuni zinaweza kutoa hisa zaidi wakati wowote, zikipunguza thamani ya wamiliki waliopo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya biashara masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki kwenye masoko ya kimataifa.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina ada za usimamizi, ada za broker, au gharama za uwazi. Hisa zinahusu ada za uchaguzi za hisa, ada za fedha, na malipo ya broker yanayopunguza mapato yako halisi.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, you can take self-custody of your coins, meaning you truly own them without depending on any third party.

entries.currentValue: Na Bitcoin, unaweza kuchukua uhifadhi wa kibinafsi wa sarafu zako, ikimaanisha wewe kweli unazimiliki bila kutegemea mhusika wa tatu yeyote.
entries.targetTranslation: Sheria za Bitcoin zimewekwa katika msimbo na haziwezi kubadilishwa kwa hiari. Sera za kampuni — gawio, kugawanya hisa, kununua tena — zinaweza kubadilika ghafla na kuathiri thamani yako.

entries.currentValue: Uhifadhi wa kibinafsi ni rahisi kama kupakua programu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Stocks require a brokerage account and you're subject to counterparty risk - if the company goes bankrupt or the brokerage fails, you could lose your investment.
entries.englishValue: of Bitcoin with a simple app — no broker needed. Stocks sit with brokerages, exposing you to counterparty risk if they fail.
entries.currentValue: Hisa zinahitaji akaunti ya dalali na unakabiliwa na hatari ya mhusika mwingine - ikiwa kampuni itafilisika au dalali atashindwa, unaweza kupoteza uwekezaji wako.
entries.targetTranslation: wa Bitcoin kwa programu rahisi — hakuna broker anayehitajika. Hisa zinakaa na mawakala wa madalali, ukiweka hatari ya mhusika mwingine kama wakishindwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a fixed supply asset with a hard cap of 21 million Bitcoin that will ever exist. This makes it a great inflation hedge. Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ni mali yenye ugavi uliowekwa na kikomo cha juu cha Bitcoin milioni 21 ambazo zitawepo. Hii inafanya kuwa kinga nzuri ya mfumuko wa bei. Hisa zina utendaji tofauti dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei - baadhi ya makampuni yanafanya vizuri wakati wa mfumuko wa bei wakati mengine yanasumbuliwa. Hakuna uhakika kuwa hisa yoyote maalum italinda dhidi ya mfumuko wa bei.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haitegemei serikali yoyote au mfumo wa kisheria. Hisa zinaweza kuteseka kutokana na mabadiliko ya udhibiti, ushuru, au sera za kampuni katika nchi maalum.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ni mtandao wazi ambao mtu yeyote anaweza kujiunge na kutumia bila ruhusa. Mitandao ya kadi za mkopo kama Visa ni mifumo iliyofungwa inayodhibitiwa na taasisi za fedha ambazo zinaweza kumzuia mtu yeyote ufikiaji.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina mamlaka kuu inayoweza kuzuia, kugandamisha, au kurudisha miamala. Visa inaweza na inafanya hivi kila mara kwa amri ya serikali, sera za kampuni, au algorithmu za udanganyifu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transactions have no fees for merchants, while credit card companies typically charge merchants around 3% per transaction.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin transactions have no merchant fees. Visa typically charges merchants around 3% per transaction — your business can save money accepting
entries.currentValue: Miamala ya Bitcoin haina ada kwa wafanyabiashara, wakati makampuni ya kadi za mkopo kwa kawaida huwatoza wafanyabiashara takriban 3% kwa kila muamala.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haihitaji ya udhibiti — mtu yeyote duniani anaweza kuitumia. Visa ina mahitaji ya udhibiti yanayoweza kuwatenga mabilioni — wasio na akaunti za benki, watu wenye historia mbaya za mikopo, au wasio na karatasi sahihi.

entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inafanya kazi kwenye blockchain ya uwazi ambapo miamala yote inaweza kuthibitishwa na mtu yeyote. Mitandao ya kadi za mkopo inafanya kazi kama mifumo iliyofungwa, ya kibinafsi ambapo maelezo ya miamala yamefichwa kutoka mtazamo wa umma.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit card companies can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time. Bitcoin cannot be frozen or controlled by any central authority.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.
entries.currentValue: Makampuni ya kadi za mkopo yanaweza kugandamisha akaunti, kuzuia miamala, au kukataa huduma wakati wowote. Bitcoin haiwezi kugandamishwa au kudhibitiwa na mamlaka yoyote kuu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin haina kazi tena. Visa ina pointi moja ya kushindikana — hata vipindi vifupi vya kuzima kunaweza kupooza biashara duniani kote.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is final-settlement — you can only spend what you own. Credit cards create debt with interest rates often over 25% a year.
entries.currentValue: Kadi za mkopo zinaunda deni ambalo linaweza kujikusanya riba ya juu kama hailipi haraka, wakati mwingine inazidi 25% kwa mwaka.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin inalinda faragha yako kwa anwani za kifani. Visa hufuatilia kila ununuzi unaoufanya, kujenga wasifu wa kina wa tabia zako za matumizi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: Kukubali Bitcoin kuna faida nyingi kama kukubali malipo kwa ada ndogo na kupata wateja zaidi.
entries.targetTranslation: Njia rahisi zaidi ya kukubali Bitcoin ni kwa pochi mseto inayouza kiotomatiki 100% ya Bitcoin unayopokea kwa dola (au sarafu yako ya ndani) papo hapo malipo yanapokuja.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Ukitumia Pochi ya Mseto kutoka Mwongozo wetu wa Pochi na kuuza moja kwa moja 100% ya Bitcoin unayopokea kwa dola, huhitaji kufanya mabadiliko yoyote katika uhasibu wako wa sasa.
entries.targetTranslation: Kwa mpangilio huu, vitabu vyako vinaonekana kama vinavyofanya leo — nambari ya mwisho iko katika dola, kila wakati. Hakuna msingi wa gharama, hakuna faida za mtaji, hakuna lahajedwali mpya.

entries.currentValue: KUFUATILIA MSINGI WAKO WA GHARAMA
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa unaweka Bitcoin fulani: kufuatilia msingi wako wa gharama

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Kufuatilia msingi wako wa gharama itakuwa tofauti kubwa zaidi kati ya uhasibu wa dola na uhasibu wa Bitcoin. Hata ukiona biashara yako kabisa kwa Bitcoin, unahitaji kuripoti thamani ya dola ya kila muamala kwenye kodi zako.
entries.targetTranslation: Baadhi ya biashara huchagua kuweka sehemu ya Bitcoin wanayopokea badala ya kuibadilisha kiotomatiki yote. Ikiwa hivyo ndivyo wewe, hatua kuu ya ziada ni kufuatilia msingi wa gharama yako — thamani ya dola ya kila malipo ya Bitcoin siku uliyopokea.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Ukitumia QuickBooks, unaweza kufanya hivi kiotomatiki ukitumia programu-jalizi ya Bitcoin Sync.
entries.targetTranslation: Hata ukifikiria biashara yako kabisa katika Bitcoin, mamlaka nyingi za kodi bado hutaka thamani ya dola iripotiwe. Habari njema: ni nambari mbili tu kwa kila muamala — kiasi cha Bitcoin kilichopokelewa na thamani yake ya dola siku hiyo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Mfumuko wa bei hutokea wakati pesa zaidi zinachapishwa au kuundwa kutoka hewani. Hii inafanya pesa yako kuwa na thamani ndogo kwa muda.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ina ugavi uliowekwa, ikimaanisha hakuna mtu anayeweza kuchapisha Bitcoin zaidi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Benki kadhaa za Marekani zimeanguka katika miaka michache iliyopita kutokana na mikimbilio ya benki.
entries.targetTranslation: Benki kadhaa za Marekani zimeanguka katika miaka ya hivi karibuni kwa sababu ya mikimbilio ya benki. Wakati wateja wengi sana walipojaribu kutoa kwa wakati mmoja, benki hazikuwa na fedha za kulipa kila mtu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Badala ya kushikilia pesa yako tu kwa ajili yako, benki zinawekeza na kukopesha pesa yako. Kama uwekezaji huo haukufanikiwa vizuri, hawana pesa za kutosha kukulipa.
entries.targetTranslation: Badala ya kushikilia tu pesa zako, benki zinaazima na kuwekeza nyingi. Uwekezaji huo ukienda vibaya — au wenye amana wakipoteza imani — benki inaweza kushindwa, na amana zako zinaweza kufungwa au kupotea.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Na mfuko wa bima wa FDIC una $1 tu kwa kila $100 wanayobima.
entries.targetTranslation: Na Bitcoin, unaweza kushikilia pesa zako mwenyewe moja kwa moja katika pochi yako mwenyewe. Hakuna benki. Hakuna msuluhishi. Hakuna mkimbilio wa benki.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Tofauti na mitandao ya kawaida ya fedha, Bitcoin haihitaji ruhusa kutumika.
entries.targetTranslation: Tofauti na kadi za mkopo, PayPal, au akaunti za kawaida za benki, Bitcoin haihitaji ruhusa ya mtu yeyote kuitumia.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Hiyo inamaanisha hakuna mtu anayeweza kukuzuia kutumia Bitcoin kwa sababu yoyote. Ni mtandao wa kwanza wa fedha unaoweza kutumia bila hofu ya udhibiti au kunyang'anywa.
entries.targetTranslation: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kugandamisha akaunti yako, kuzuia malipo, au kukukata kutoka kwenye mtandao. Ni mfumo wa kwanza wa fedha katika historia unaoweza kutumia bila woga wa udhibiti au kunyang'anywa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ni teknolojia isiyoeleweka vizuri ambayo inajenga ulimwengu bora.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin mara nyingi inaeleweka vibaya, lakini inafanya kazi nzuri sana kimya kimya duniani.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin imewezesha wanaharakati wa haki za binadamu kupigania uhuru, imepunguza utoaji wa methane duniani, imehifadhi hifadhi za taifa, na mengi zaidi.
entries.targetTranslation: Imewasaidia wanaharakati wa haki za binadamu kupigania uhuru, kupunguza uzalishaji wa methani duniani kutoka kwenye mashimo ya taka na maeneo ya mafuta, kuimarisha gridi za umeme, na kufadhili bidhaa za umma kama hifadhi za kitaifa.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.

entries.englishValue: As long as you hold bitcoin in your own wallet — not on an exchange or wrapped in an ETF — bank runs are impossible.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Kukubali Bitcoin katika biashara yako hakuhitaji kufanya uhasibu wako kuwa mgumu. Hapa kuna toleo fupi — pamoja na zana na wataalamu kuifanya isiyo na maumivu.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa tayari unakubali fedha taslimu au kadi, kuongeza Bitcoin kwenye vitabu vyako vya biashara ni rahisi kuliko inavyoonekana. Una njia mbili: kubadilisha kiotomatiki kila malipo ya Bitcoin kuwa dola wakati yanapofika (hakuna uhasibu mpya unaohitajika), au kuweka baadhi kama Bitcoin (nambari chache za ziada za kufuatilia).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Mwongozo huu unakuongoza kupitia zote mbili — ili uweze kuchagua ile inayofaa biashara yako na kuanza kukubali Bitcoin kwa ujasiri.

entries.englishValue: The easy path: auto-convert to dollars
entries.targetTranslation: Njia rahisi: badilisha kiotomatiki kuwa dola

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.
entries.targetTranslation: Ndio hivyo. Hesabu ya msingi inafanana kabisa na jinsi mali nyingine yoyote inayoongezeka au kupungua thamani inavyofanyiwa uhasibu.

entries.englishValue: Accept Bitcoin at your business for lower fees, instant settlement, no chargebacks, and more customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Kubali Bitcoin katika biashara yako kwa ada za chini, makazi ya papo hapo, hakuna kurudisha malipo, na wateja zaidi.

entries.englishValue: Accept payments with lower fees, get paid instantly, and reach millions of new customers — with zero contracts and zero hidden costs.
entries.targetTranslation: Kubali malipo kwa ada za chini, lipa papo hapo, na ufikie mamilioni ya wateja wapya — bila mikataba na bila gharama zilizofichwa.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin huipa biashara yako njia ya haraka, ya bei nafuu, na ya faragha zaidi ya kupokea malipo. Hakuna wasuluhishi. Hakuna kurudisha malipo. Hakuna mikataba. Pesa tu zinazokaa ndani ya sekunde, moja kwa moja kutoka kwa wateja wako kwako.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why Bitcoin is good for business — and below that, every resource you need to start accepting it today.
entries.targetTranslation: Hapa chini ni toleo fupi la kwa nini Bitcoin ni nzuri kwa biashara — na chini yake, kila nyenzo unayohitaji kuanza kukubali leo.

entries.englishValue: Work through these resources at your own pace. Each one is a short, practical guide.
entries.targetTranslation: Pitia nyenzo hizi kwa kasi yako mwenyewe. Kila moja ni mwongozo mfupi, wa vitendo.

entries.targetTranslation: Tueleze kuhusu biashara yako

entries.englishValue: We only need a few details to get you listed. Address data is kept only long enough to submit your business to the maps.
entries.targetTranslation: Tunahitaji maelezo machache tu ili kukuorodhesha. Data ya anwani huhifadhiwa kwa muda wa kutosha tu kuwasilisha biashara yako kwenye ramani.

entries.englishValue: List your business for free on BTC Map — the open, worldwide directory of Bitcoin-accepting merchants — so Bitcoiners nearby can find you and spend Bitcoin at your business.
entries.targetTranslation: Orodhesha biashara yako bure kwenye BTC Map — orodha ya wazi, ya kimataifa ya wafanyabiashara wanaokubali Bitcoin — ili Wabitcoiners walio karibu wakupate na watumie Bitcoin kwenye biashara yako.

entries.englishValue: Get your business on Bitcoin merchant maps
entries.targetTranslation: Pata biashara yako kwenye ramani za wafanyabiashara wa Bitcoin

entries.englishValue: Bitcoiners actively look for places to spend. Getting your business on the map puts you in front of every Bitcoin user searching for somewhere to eat, shop, or stay nearby — at zero cost to you.
entries.targetTranslation: Wabitcoiners hutafuta kikamilifu mahali pa kutumia. Kupata biashara yako kwenye ramani kunakuweka mbele ya kila mtumiaji wa Bitcoin anayetafuta mahali pa kula, kununua, au kukaa karibu — bila gharama yoyote kwako.

entries.englishValue: Just fill out the short form below and we'll submit your business to BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant maps for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Jaza tu fomu fupi hapa chini na tutawasilisha biashara yako kwa BTC Map na ramani nyingine za wafanyabiashara wa Bitcoin kwa niaba yako.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin is only half the job — your customers also need to know that you do. These small 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers are designed to stick on your front door, register, menu, or anywhere else customers will see them before they pay.
entries.targetTranslation: Kukubali Bitcoin ni nusu tu ya kazi — wateja wako pia wanahitaji kujua kuwa unakubali. Stika hizi ndogo za 'Bitcoin Inakubaliwa Hapa' zimeundwa kushikamana kwenye mlango wako wa mbele, rejista, menyu, au mahali pengine ambapo wateja wataziona kabla ya kulipa.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Pochi za Bitcoin ni za bure. Chagua inayofaa biashara yako — ana kwa ana, mtandaoni, au kwa msingi wa ankara — na uanze kukubali Bitcoin ndani ya dakika.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Pochi kwa biashara za msingi wa ankara

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa unatuma ankara kwa wateja (ushauri, kazi za kujitegemea, huduma za B2B), tumia pochi iliyoundwa kuzunguka utengenezaji wa ankara. Mteja wako analipa ankara ya Bitcoin kwa kubonyeza mara kadhaa.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Pochi kwa biashara zenye wafanyakazi wengi

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa una timu inayopokea malipo kwenye rejista, chagua pochi inayosaidia kuingia kwa wafanyakazi wengi — ili kila mfanyakazi apate PIN yake mwenyewe na uweke kumbukumbu safi ya nani alichukua malipo gani.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Pochi kwa biashara za mtandaoni

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Unauza kwenye tovuti? Pochi hizi zinaunganisha kwenye duka lako la mtandaoni na kukubali Bitcoin kutoka kwa mteja yeyote, popote duniani — bila kurudisha malipo, bila akaunti ya mfanyabiashara inayohitajika.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Pochi kwa biashara zinazomilikiwa kibinafsi

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa unaendesha duka, mkahawa wa kahawa, studio, au huduma peke yako, pochi yoyote ya hizi itafanya kazi. Chagua kulingana na ikiwa unataka kuweka malipo katika Bitcoin au kubadilisha kiotomatiki sehemu ya kila malipo kuwa sarafu yako ya ndani.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business hukuruhusu kukubali malipo ya Bitcoin na Lightning bila ada na makazi ya papo hapo. Inasaidia malipo ya ana kwa ana, mtandaoni, na ya msingi wa ankara na ubadilishaji wa hiari kuwa sarafu yako ya ndani.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Ada za chini, zaidi kwa biashara

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Malipo ya Bitcoin yanapita benki na kampuni za kadi za mkopo zinazochukua 2–3% kutoka kwa kila mauzo. Biashara inashikilia zaidi ya unayolipa — ambayo mara nyingi inamaanisha bei bora na huduma bora kwako.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Makazi ya papo hapo, hakuna kurudisha malipo

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Malipo ya Bitcoin yanakaa ndani ya sekunde, moja kwa moja kutoka kwa pochi yako kwa biashara. Hakuna kusubiri siku za benki kutoa fedha, na hakuna mizozo ya gharama ya kurudisha malipo — kwa hivyo biashara inaweza kuzingatia kuhudumia wateja badala ya kupambana na udanganyifu.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Bure kukubali, wazi kwa kila mtu

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Hakuna mikataba, ada za kila mwezi, au gharama za kuanzisha kwa biashara kukubali Bitcoin. Na mamilioni ya watumiaji wa Bitcoin duniani kote hutafuta kikamilifu wafanyabiashara wanaokubali — na kuipa biashara hii mfichuko wa bure kwa wateja wapya.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Kukubali Bitcoin huiruhusu biashara kushikilia zaidi ya kila mauzo, kulipa papo hapo bila kurudisha malipo, na kufikia hadhira ya kimataifa ya watumiaji wa Bitcoin — vyote bila mikataba na bila ada za kila mwezi.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin sio tu ina manufaa katika rejista — ni aina bora ya pesa inayolinda akiba yako, faragha yako, na uhuru wako wa kufanya muamala. Hapa kuna muhtasari mfupi.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Umepiga skana stika ya Bitcoin Inakubaliwa Hapa. Hapa kuna sababu ya hilo kuwa habari njema — kwa biashara hii, na kwako.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Biashara uliyo nayo inakubali Bitcoin — mtandao wa kisasa, wa chanzo huria wa malipo ambao mtu yeyote anaweza kuutumia, popote duniani, bila benki au wasuluhishi kuchukua sehemu.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Wateja wa Nostr ni programu za bure zinazokuruhusu kusoma na kuchapisha kwenye mtandao wa Nostr. Wote wanaweza kufanya kazi pamoja — unaweza kubadilisha wateja wakati wowote na kubaki na wafuasi na maudhui yako.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr ni itifaki mpya iliyogatuliwa ya kuwasiliana mtandaoni — hakuna kampuni moja inayoidhibiti, Bitcoin zaps zimejengwa ndani, na unaweza kuhama kati ya programu bila kupoteza wafuasi wako.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr ni nini?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr ni sawa na barua pepe: hakuna mtu anayemiliki itifaki, mtu yeyote anaweza kujenga programu juu yake, na unaweza kuchagua programu yoyote unayopenda zaidi. Tofauti na Twitter au Facebook, hakuna kampuni kuu inayoweza kukuzuia, kukutoa kwenye jukwaa, au kupunguza ufikiaji wako.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr ni itifaki mpya inayokuruhusu kuwasiliana mtandaoni bila kuogopa udhibiti, kutolewa kwenye jukwaa, au kupunguzwa.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Majukwaa kama Twitter na Facebook yanadhibitiwa na kampuni moja, lakini hakuna mtu anayedhibiti itifaki ya Nostr.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Uhuru wa kuhama

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr ni sawa na barua pepe. Hakuna mtu anayedhibiti itifaki ya barua pepe, na mtu yeyote anaweza kujenga mteja (kama Gmail, Hotmail, n.k.) juu yake.

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Hakuna mtu anayedhibiti itifaki ya Nostr pia, na mtu yeyote anaweza kujenga mteja (kama Damus, Amethyst, n.k.) juu yake.

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ikiwa hupendi jinsi mteja fulani anavyofanya kazi, unaweza kuhamishia akaunti yako ya Nostr kwa mteja mwingine bila kupoteza wafuasi au maudhui yako.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin imejengwa ndani

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin imejengwa ndani kwa asili katika itifaki ya Nostr. Ukiona maudhui unayopenda, unaweza kwa urahisi kumtumia Bitcoin mtu kama shukrani!

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Kwenye majukwaa yaliyo na umoja kama Twitter na Facebook, kampuni iliyo na umoja inapata pesa kutokana na maudhui yako. Lakini kwenye itifaki wazi kama Nostr, wewe ndiwe unayepata pesa kutokana na maudhui yako.
